text:
Mia Chen: Heads-up — HelixHealth (acct: HLX-9921) autopay failed for INV-54321. Payment processor returned `card_declined` and `issuer_do_not_honor`. Customer is EU; card on file expires 05/24. Billing shows `autopay_method=card_token`

billing-bot: PAYMENT ATTEMPT #3 for INV-54321 failed. amount: 12,450.00 USD. processor: Stripe. attempt_id: att_1Jk9x... status: failed

Samir Patel: Can you paste the raw attempt log? Check for SCA required flag or `three_d_secure`.

Mia Chen: pasting log snippet:
```json
{"attempt_id":"att_1Jk9x","status":"failed","decline_code":"issuer_declined","three_d_secure":"required","last4":"4242","exp_month":5,"exp_year":2024}
```

Adrian (Finance): That's SCA territory. For EU customers we need re-auth for cards. Options: (1) Send hosted paylink for one-off payment (2) Pause autopay and have CS re-collect card (3) Switch to manual invoice + wire. Which do we prefer for Helix?

Nora (CS): I'll ping the customer. @Mia do we have a paylink flow ready? Also confirm retry cadence — can we do 24h spacing or does payments policy require 48h?

Mia Chen: We have hosted paylink: https://billing.redwood.com/pay/INV-54321?token=eyJ... (exp 48h). I'll configure retries at 24h, 48h, 72h and mark account `dunning-high` after final fail.

Adrian (Finance): Approve retry schedule. Also propose waiving late fee if they complete payment within 7 days of first failure. @Samir approve?

Samir Patel: OK to waive late fee for this incident. Also set `require_reauth=true` on next autopay attempt so Stripe triggers SCA flow.

Nora (CS): Calling Helix now. Note: card on file exp 05/24 — likely token rotation needed. If they prefer wire, we'll send the SOC-approved wire template and request remittance. @Mia please attach wire template to the customer thread.

Mia Chen: Wire template referenced: WIRE_INSTR_HELIX.pdf (internal). If they wire, route to treasury for confirmation and mark invoice `PAID_MANUAL` once funds settle.

billing-bot: Created follow-up task #FIN-8327 assigned to Nora. Auto-retry schedule configured: [24h, 48h, 72h].

Adrian (Finance): Timeline: Nora updates by EOD with customer preference, Finance confirms fee waiver after payment posts, Mia to update invoice status. Mark this resolved after payment posts.

Nora (CS): :thumbsup: will update in thread after call.
